# FEATURE-MAP — S275 earned-work kernel

| User goal | Entrypoint | Command | State | Tests | Account prerequisite |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Outside operator funds a task, a contributor claims and submits artifact metadata, owner verifies and accepts; payout stays an IOU | `services/earned-work` HTTP (`POST /v1/tasks` → reserve → claim → submit → verdict → accept → `GET /v1/tasks/:id/payout`) | `./scripts/pg-fixture.sh` then `EARNED_WORK_OWNER_TOKEN=dev-owner-token-s275 EARNED_WORK_DATABASE_URL=postgres://earned_work:earned_work@127.0.0.1:55432/earned_work_test npm test` and `./scripts/curl-journey.sh`. Live F07: boot HTTP on `127.0.0.1:8791`, then `EARNED_WORK_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8791 node src/run.mjs` from `packs/outside-operator-journey-harness`. Contributor token from `POST /v1/contributor-tokens` | `unfunded → reserved → claimed → submitted → verified → owed` with `payoutState=owed`, `transfer=null`, `paid=false`, `settled=false`. `termsVersion` is F17 `hashTermsVersion` (`sha256:` + 64 hex). Integer claim keys are rejected. GET `/v1/tasks/:id` includes A3 `workability` (`doNotStartWork`, mixedScore `displayOnly`, `claimAuthority` never `agent` from HTTP 200). Exclusive occupancy: `slotLimit` default 1, second claim `reserved_elsewhere`. | `npm test --prefix services/earned-work` (node:test, real Postgres + real HTTP) including `tests/terms-version.test.ts`, `tests/work-gate.test.ts`, changed-terms, concurrent-claim, permissions, public-redaction. Curl journey plus seeded contributor-accept rejection in `scripts/curl-journey.sh` | Local env tokens only (`EARNED_WORK_OWNER_TOKEN=dev-owner-token-s275`). No production Neomorphic, Stripe, or chain account. Banked 8.105 USDC is not spendable. |
| Root imports a capped opportunity round, a holder submits existing evidence, and a full or mismatched applicant gets a waitlist instead of a closed relationship | `services/earned-work` `/v1/opportunity-rounds` plus `scripts/opportunity.mjs`. Closed trial JSON names the round with null delivery paths until Root hosts it (`src/lib/opportunity-continuation.mjs`) | `EARNED_WORK_DATABASE_URL=postgres://earned_work:earned_work@127.0.0.1:55432/earned_work_test node --import tsx scripts/opportunity-receive.mjs` | Fixture round `agent-opportunity-221400-v1`: cap `300000`, ten `10000` discovery imports, three synthetic `50000` assignments, `250000` committed, `50000` remaining. Accept is `null_nonpaying_v0`, `paid=false`, `transfer=null`. Full discovery is HTTP 409 with `doNotStartWork=true`. | `tests/opportunity-intake.test.ts`, `tests/opportunity-receive.test.ts`, `tests/opportunity-openapi.test.ts` | Same local owner token. Fixture credential refs are not production grants. No chain account and no transfer. |
